known_limitations.detail: FastAPI endpoints and end-to-end real API integration are planned.
Grayscale, CLAHE, annotation, severity, and the composed inspection service are deferred to the next milestone.
The 17-class alternative required a 0.05 diagnostic threshold and produced two detections on one of three NEU-DET probe images; the stronger six-class model is selected.
SQLite metadata, media persistence, real filtering, deletion, clearing, and CSV export are planned.
The required ten-image manufacturing dataset and provenance manifest are not present.
Real model inference is verified; live backend, annotated image, persistence, and server CSV paths are not runtime-verified.
Detection unit tests, import-boundary checks, frontend utility tests, and builds exist; component, API, and end-to-end automation remain planned.
